scenes.big: Quiz: why does your head hurt?
scenes.say: Quick quiz. A headache after hours on a screen or a book. Is it your eyes, the screen, or both?

scenes.en: Up close, your focusing muscle works nonstop, and you blink less.
scenes.ta: அருகில் பார்க்கும்போது கண் தசை ஓயாமல் வேலை செய்கிறது
scenes.say: The answer is both. Up close, a tiny focusing muscle in your eye works nonstop. You also blink less, so your eyes dry out. That tension shows up as a headache.

scenes.en: Eye strain doesn't permanently damage your eyes. Uncorrected power makes it worse.
scenes.say: Did you know? Eye strain does not permanently damage your eyes. But a small, uncorrected power can make the headaches much worse.

scenes.en: Every 20 minutes, look 20 feet away for 20 seconds.
scenes.say: Step one. Every twenty minutes, look at something twenty feet away, for twenty seconds.

scenes.en: An arm's length away, slightly below eye level, no window glare.
scenes.ta: திரை ஒரு கை தூரத்தில், கண் மட்டத்துக்குக் கீழே
scenes.say: Step two. Keep the screen an arm's length away, slightly below eye level, with no window glare on it.

scenes.en: Blink fully. Read in good light.
scenes.ta: முழுமையாகக் கண் சிமிட்டுங்கள், நல்ல வெளிச்சத்தில் படியுங்கள்
scenes.say: Step three. Blink fully and often, and read in good light.

scenes.en: A sudden severe headache with eye pain, redness, blur or halos.
scenes.ta: கண் வலி, சிவப்பு, மங்கல் இருந்தால் உடனே கண் மருத்துவரிடம்
scenes.say: See an eye specialist urgently if a sudden severe headache comes with eye pain, redness, blurred vision, or rainbow halos around lights.
Still getting headaches? Book an eye test and check your power.
